name: [Amazons] RiderTime
desc:
(This Game Got Inspiration From Kamen Rider Series) 
You Can Choose Your Favorite Char And Transform Into Kamen Rider
I Hope You Enjoy This Game

Click - M1
Q - Dash [Q+Space To Boost Dash]
Y - Pose
E - Transform
R,T,F,G = Skill
X - Mode [Some Char Doesn't Have It Yet]
V - Emote
Ctrl - Walk/Run

ShutDown = Update Or Fix Something
If You Got Some Idea You Can Suggestion It On Our Server
Hope You Enjoy!
